Definition: properly, length, i.e. a measure (of uncertain dimension)
BiblicalUsage: Kibrah is a little way, a short measure of distance. Genesis 35:16 says there was but a little way to come to Ephrath when Rachel travailed and died, and Genesis 48:7 has Jacob remembering the same road and the same loss. 2 Kings 5:19 uses it once more, when Naaman departs from Elisha a little way.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a little way can hold a whole life: Rachel died a little way from Ephrath, and Jacob never forgot the road.
